mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of UNRATE < 3.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that increases corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) during supply chain disruptions indicates reduced output and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >60% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%) triggers monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of RSAFS growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High labor force growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) pressures corporate margins through rising wages, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >60% of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and slow GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.0%) signals broad economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized
failure_condition: Joint signal of declining INDPRO and slow GDPC1 growth fails to predict negative returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
